question: This is a comprehensive system. For user management, the system maintains basic user information including user ID, username, password, phone number, and WeChat OpenID, while recording detailed user information including name, QQ number, email, registration time, and account status. For news management, the system manages news information including news ID, title, content, publication time, and read count, maintains news categories including category ID, category name, and sort order, and manages news status including draft, published, and unpublished states. For video management, the system maintains basic video information including video ID, title, description, cover image, and duration, records detailed video information including directory structure, course count, total duration, and price, manages video status (unpublished, published, unpublished) and video categories (category ID, category name, parent category). For instructor management, the system maintains instructor information including instructor ID, name, avatar, title, and introduction, records instructor qualifications including years of teaching experience, professional field, and teaching achievements, and manages associated videos, i.e., the list of courses taught. The system also includes collection management functionality, recording collection records (user ID, video ID, collection time) and collection status (validity). For order management, the system maintains order information (user ID, video ID, order time), records payment information (payment amount, payment method, payment status, payment time) and order status (pending payment, paid, cancelled). For learning records, the system manages purchase records (user ID, video ID, purchase time, expiration time) and learning progress (viewing duration, last viewing time, completion status).

-- Schema for database: rschema_0420
CREATE TABLE `user_info` (
  `user_id` int(11) NOT NULL AUTO_INCREMENT,
  `username` varchar(255) NOT NULL,
  `password` varchar(255) NOT NULL,
  `phone_number` varchar(20) DEFAULT NULL,
  `wechat_openid` varchar(255) DEFAULT NULL,
  `name` varchar(255) DEFAULT NULL,
  `qq_number` varchar(20) DEFAULT NULL,
  `email` varchar(255) DEFAULT NULL,
  `registration_time` datetime DEFAULT NULL,
  `account_status` tinyint(4) NOT NULL DEFAULT '1',
  PRIMARY KEY (`user_id`),
  UNIQUE KEY `uk_user_info_username` (`username`),
  UNIQUE KEY `uk_user_info_phone_number` (`phone_number`),
  UNIQUE KEY `uk_user_info_wechat_openid` (`wechat_openid`)
) ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb3;

CREATE TABLE `news_category` (
  `category_id` int(11) NOT NULL AUTO_INCREMENT,
  `category_name` varchar(255) NOT NULL,
  `sort_order` int(11) NOT NULL DEFAULT '0',
  PRIMARY KEY (`category_id`)
) ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb3;

CREATE TABLE `news_info` (
  `news_id` int(11) NOT NULL AUTO_INCREMENT,
  `category_id` int(11) DEFAULT NULL,
  `title` varchar(255) NOT NULL,
  `content` text NOT NULL,
  `publication_time` datetime DEFAULT NULL,
  `read_count` int(11) NOT NULL DEFAULT '0',
  `news_status` tinyint(4) NOT NULL DEFAULT '0',
  PRIMARY KEY (`news_id`),
  KEY `news_info_ibfk_1` (`category_id`),
  CONSTRAINT `news_info_ibfk_1` FOREIGN KEY (`category_id`) REFERENCES `news_category` (`category_id`) ON DELETE SET NULL ON UPDATE CASCADE
) ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb3;

CREATE TABLE `video_category` (
  `category_id` int(11) NOT NULL AUTO_INCREMENT,
  `category_name` varchar(255) NOT NULL,
  `parent_category_id` int(11) DEFAULT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY (`category_id`),
  KEY `video_category_ibfk_1` (`parent_category_id`),
  CONSTRAINT `video_category_ibfk_1` FOREIGN KEY (`parent_category_id`) REFERENCES `video_category` (`category_id`) ON DELETE SET NULL ON UPDATE CASCADE
) ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb3;

CREATE TABLE `video_info` (
  `video_id` int(11) NOT NULL AUTO_INCREMENT,
  `category_id` int(11) DEFAULT NULL,
  `title` varchar(255) NOT NULL,
  `description` text DEFAULT NULL,
  `cover_image` varchar(255) DEFAULT NULL,
  `duration` int(11) DEFAULT NULL,
  `directory_structure` varchar(500) DEFAULT NULL,
  `course_count` int(11) NOT NULL DEFAULT '0',
  `total_duration` int(11) NOT NULL DEFAULT '0',
  `price` decimal(10,2) NOT NULL DEFAULT '0.00',
  `video_status` tinyint(4) NOT NULL DEFAULT '0',
  PRIMARY KEY (`video_id`),
  KEY `video_info_ibfk_1` (`category_id`),
  CONSTRAINT `video_info_ibfk_1` FOREIGN KEY (`category_id`) REFERENCES `video_category` (`category_id`) ON DELETE SET NULL ON UPDATE CASCADE
) ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb3;

CREATE TABLE `instructor_info` (
  `instructor_id` int(11) NOT NULL AUTO_INCREMENT,
  `name` varchar(255) NOT NULL,
  `avatar` varchar(255) DEFAULT NULL,
  `title` varchar(255) DEFAULT NULL,
  `introduction` text DEFAULT NULL,
  `years_of_teaching_experience` int(11) DEFAULT NULL,
  `professional_field` varchar(255) DEFAULT NULL,
  `teaching_achievements` text DEFAULT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY (`instructor_id`)
) ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb3;

CREATE TABLE `instructor_video` (
  `id` int(11) NOT NULL AUTO_INCREMENT,
  `instructor_id` int(11) NOT NULL,
  `video_id` int(11) NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY (`id`),
  UNIQUE KEY `uk_instructor_video` (`instructor_id`,`video_id`),
  KEY `instructor_video_ibfk_2` (`video_id`),
  CONSTRAINT `instructor_video_ibfk_1` FOREIGN KEY (`instructor_id`) REFERENCES `instructor_info` (`instructor_id`) ON DELETE CASCADE ON UPDATE CASCADE,
  CONSTRAINT `instructor_video_ibfk_2` FOREIGN KEY (`video_id`) REFERENCES `video_info` (`video_id`) ON DELETE CASCADE ON UPDATE CASCADE
) ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb3;

CREATE TABLE `collection_record` (
  `collection_id` int(11) NOT NULL AUTO_INCREMENT,
  `user_id` int(11) NOT NULL,
  `video_id` int(11) NOT NULL,
  `collection_time` datetime NOT NULL,
  `collection_status` tinyint(4) NOT NULL DEFAULT '1',
  PRIMARY KEY (`collection_id`),
  UNIQUE KEY `uk_collection_record` (`user_id`,`video_id`),
  KEY `collection_record_ibfk_2` (`video_id`),
  CONSTRAINT `collection_record_ibfk_1` FOREIGN KEY (`user_id`) REFERENCES `user_info` (`user_id`) ON DELETE CASCADE ON UPDATE CASCADE,
  CONSTRAINT `collection_record_ibfk_2` FOREIGN KEY (`video_id`) REFERENCES `video_info` (`video_id`) ON DELETE CASCADE ON UPDATE CASCADE
) ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb3;

CREATE TABLE `order_info` (
  `order_id` int(11) NOT NULL AUTO_INCREMENT,
  `user_id` int(11) NOT NULL,
  `video_id` int(11) NOT NULL,
  `order_time` datetime NOT NULL,
  `payment_amount` decimal(10,2) DEFAULT NULL,
  `payment_method` varchar(50) DEFAULT NULL,
  `payment_status` tinyint(4) NOT NULL DEFAULT '0',
  `payment_time` datetime DEFAULT NULL,
  `order_status` tinyint(4) NOT NULL DEFAULT '0',
  PRIMARY KEY (`order_id`),
  KEY `order_info_ibfk_1` (`user_id`),
  KEY `order_info_ibfk_2` (`video_id`),
  CONSTRAINT `order_info_ibfk_1` FOREIGN KEY (`user_id`) REFERENCES `user_info` (`user_id`) ON DELETE CASCADE ON UPDATE CASCADE,
  CONSTRAINT `order_info_ibfk_2` FOREIGN KEY (`video_id`) REFERENCES `video_info` (`video_id`) ON DELETE CASCADE ON UPDATE CASCADE
) ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb3;

CREATE TABLE `learning_record` (
  `record_id` int(11) NOT NULL AUTO_INCREMENT,
  `user_id` int(11) NOT NULL,
  `video_id` int(11) NOT NULL,
  `purchase_time` datetime NOT NULL,
  `expiration_time` datetime DEFAULT NULL,
  `viewing_duration` int(11) NOT NULL DEFAULT '0',
  `last_viewing_time` datetime DEFAULT NULL,
  `completion_status` tinyint(4) NOT NULL DEFAULT '0',
  PRIMARY KEY (`record_id`),
  UNIQUE KEY `uk_learning_record` (`user_id`,`video_id`),
  KEY `learning_record_ibfk_2` (`video_id`),
  CONSTRAINT `learning_record_ibfk_1` FOREIGN KEY (`user_id`) REFERENCES `user_info` (`user_id`) ON DELETE CASCADE ON UPDATE CASCADE,
  CONSTRAINT `learning_record_ibfk_2` FOREIGN KEY (`video_id`) REFERENCES `video_info` (`video_id`) ON DELETE CASCADE ON UPDATE CASCADE
) ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb3;
